title: Music City Retreat | Free Parking + Broadway
description:
A brand-new, stylish 2-bedroom apartment perfectly located just minutes from Broadway, Germantown, Gulch and the best local dining, music, and nightlife the city has to offer.

Enjoy modern comfort with:
* A bright, open living space and contemporary décor
* Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances
* Cozy bedrooms with premium bedding
* High Speed Wi-Fi and smart TVs  with Apple TV for streaming your favorites
* Free parking, easy access to downtown hotspots
* Free Laundry In Unit

The space
Kitchen & Dining:
Fully equipped kitchen with stainless steel appliances
Coffee maker, cookware, and utensils included

Living Space:
Open-concept living room with stylish décor
Smart TV with streaming apps and high-speed Wi-Fi
Comfortable sofa for relaxing after a night out on Broadway
Fold out sofa sleeper

Bedrooms:
Two bedrooms with comfortable queen-size beds
Tastefully designed with country western and music-inspired décor
Smart TV in each bedroom for streaming and relaxation

Bathroom:
Elegant Jack & Jill-style luxury bathroom with premium finishes
Fresh towels and toiletries provided for your stay

Parking & Access:
Free on-site parking

Location Highlights:
5 minutes to Broadway & Bridgestone Arena
3 minutes to Germantown’s restaurants, coffee shops, and boutiques.
Quick access to Nissan Stadium and other popular Nashville destinations

✨ Extras:
In-unit washer & dryer
Central air conditioning and heating
High-speed Wi-Fi and Smart TVs throughout

Whether you’re visiting for live music, local flavor, or a relaxing weekend, this apartment offers the perfect Nashville experience — stylish, comfortable, and close to it all!

Guest access
Guests will have full access and use 24/7. You can come and go as you like. There is an electronic lock so there are no keys to keep up with. I live near by so can help with anything you need during your stay.

Other things to note
Must Climb Steps.

One Free Parking Space on the driveway, additional cars can park on the street. 

Keyless Entry.
